dialogue.origin: 本日は、よろしくお願い致します。13：00になりましたらこちらから始めさせていただきます。
dialogue.content: Thank you for joining us today. We will begin at 1:00 PM.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ、よろしくお願いいたします。承知しました。
dialogue.content: Thank you as well. Understood.

dialogue.origin: （ありがとうございます。よろしくお願い致します。）
dialogue.content: (Thank you. I look forward to our session.)

dialogue.origin: はじめまして。今日こちらでお話されたことは許可なく外部に漏れると言う事は一切ありませんので、どうぞ安心して何でもお話してください。 まず初めに、年代と性別などお聞かせいただけますか。
dialogue.content: It's nice to meet you. Please know that everything we discuss here today is strictly confidential and won't be shared with anyone without your permission, so please feel free to talk about anything. To begin, may I ask your age range and gender?

dialogue.origin: こんにちはよろしくお願いします。女性　30代です。
dialogue.content: Hello, thank you for having me. I'm a woman in my 30s.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ、よろしくお願い致します。今日は、相談しようと思ってくれてありがとうございます。それでは、話しやすいところから大丈夫です。お聞かせいただけますか。
dialogue.content: Thank you as well. And thank you for reaching out for a consultation today. Please, you can start wherever you feel most comfortable. Would you like to tell me what's on your mind?

dialogue.origin: 兄の引きこもりで悩んでいます。兄はもともとそういう傾向がありましたが、コロナ禍で派遣切りにあって、それ以来です。
dialogue.content: I'm worried about my brother's social withdrawal. He's always had that tendency, but it's been this way since he was laid off from his temp job during the COVID-19 pandemic.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね。お兄様の事をご心配されているのですね。具体的にありがとうございます。お兄様は、もともとそういう傾向がおありだとありますが、その辺をもう少し詳しく教えて頂けますか。
dialogue.content: I see. You're concerned about your brother. Thank you for sharing that. You mentioned he originally had that tendency—could you tell me a bit more about that?

dialogue.origin: ずっと遡ると大学生の頃からだったか…昼夜逆転したような生活をして、家族と別の世界にいるみたいな感じです
dialogue.content: Looking back, I think it started when he was in college... He would sleep during the day and be up all night, and it felt like he was living in a different world from the rest of the family.

dialogue.origin: 注意したりされると、家族を拒絶して部屋に閉じこもり、勝手に自室に鍵をつけたり
dialogue.content: When we tried to caution him, he would shut the family out and lock himself in his room, and he even installed a lock on his door without permission.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか。お兄さんが大学時代から昼夜が逆転した生活を送られていた事は家族もご存じだったのですね。その時、ご家族はどんな対応をとられたのですか。
dialogue.content: I see. So your family knew that he was sleeping all day and up all night since his college days. How did your family handle that at the time?

dialogue.origin: 社会人になっても、仕事が長続きしなくて、仕事を時々しながらずっと実家に住み続けています
dialogue.content: Even after he started working, he couldn't hold down a job for long. He has continued to live at our parents' home, working on and off.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか。お兄さんは大学へは普通に通学されていらっしゃたようですか。
dialogue.content: I see. Did it seem like your brother was attending his university classes regularly?

dialogue.origin: あまり口出しはせずにいたと思います
dialogue.content: I think we mostly tried not to say too much about it.

dialogue.origin: お兄さんの様子を近くでみているので心配ですよね。
dialogue.content: Seeing your brother’s situation up close, it’s understandable to be worried.

dialogue.origin: あまりおぼえていませんが、基本的には行っていたと思います　留年まではしなかったので
dialogue.content: I don't remember clearly, but I think he generally went to his classes, since he didn't have to repeat a year.

dialogue.origin: 私は家を出たり結婚してからほとんど会っていません
dialogue.content: Since I moved out and got married, I’ve hardly seen him.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね。現在は、実家から離れて暮らされていると言う事ですね。お兄さんは、大学をきとんと卒業されて就職までされたのですね。お兄さんも立派ですね。
dialogue.content: I see. So you're currently living away from your parents' home. And your brother did graduate from university and even found a job. That's quite an accomplishment.

dialogue.origin: お兄さんは、現在一人で暮らされているのでしょうか。生活の様子もお聞かせいただけますか。
dialogue.content: Is your brother currently living alone? Could you tell me about his living situation?

dialogue.origin: 両親は健在ですが、10年ほど前に一緒に暮らせないと引っ越して家を出ました兄はそれ以来1人暮らしで、時々派遣の仕事をしたりでしたが、ここ3年は引きこもりです
dialogue.content: My parents are still around, but about 10 years ago, they moved out, saying they couldn't live with him anymore. My brother has been living alone ever since. He would do some temporary work from time to time, but for the past three years, he's been completely withdrawn.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか。では、現在一人で生活をされているというお兄さんの引きこもりの様子をお聞きしてもよろしでしょうか。現在、一緒に暮らされていないので具体的には分からないとは思いますが、ご家族から見てお兄さんは週に何回程外出されるとか。買い物にはご自分で行かれるとか、どの程度だと思われますか。
dialogue.content: I see. In that case, could you tell me about your brother's withdrawal now that he's living alone? I understand you may not know the specifics since you don't live together, but from your family's perspective, about how often does he go outside? Does he go shopping for himself? What's your sense of the situation?

dialogue.origin: 私もあまり状況はよくわからないのですが、買い物以外は外出していないと思います
dialogue.content: I don’t know the situation very well either, but I think he doesn’t go out except for shopping.

dialogue.origin: 分かりました。ありがとうございます。それは、ご心配ですね。では、妹さんはお兄さんが何故引きこもりがちになったのか。等具体的な出来事があったように思われますか。
dialogue.content: I understand, thank you. That is certainly worrying. Do you think there was a specific event that might have caused your brother to become so withdrawn?

dialogue.origin: 本人に様子を聞いたりすればいいんですけど、何か気に食わないと突然怒り始めますし、あまりまともに話せないので、私も正直言って兄とは話したくないですが、このまま放っておくのも困るので…
dialogue.content: I should probably ask him directly, but if something rubs him the wrong way he suddenly gets angry, and it’s hard to have a proper conversation. To be honest, I don’t want to talk with him either, but I also can’t just leave things as they are…

dialogue.origin: 職場で他の人とあまりうまくやっていけないのかなと思います思ったことをそのまま言ってしまうとか
dialogue.content: I think maybe he has trouble getting along with people at work. He tends to say exactly what's on his mind.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね。お兄さんが心配で話しかけても、起こり始めると話すのも不安になりますね。妹さんから見て、お兄さんは周りの方とうまくコミュケーションがとれていないように思われるのでしょうか。
dialogue.content: I see. Even when you try to speak to him out of concern, it must be unsettling when he starts to get angry. From your perspective, does it seem that your brother has trouble communicating well with the people around him?

dialogue.origin: 怒り始めると。。。です。失礼いたしました。
dialogue.content: When he starts to get angry... My apologies for the typo.

dialogue.origin: はい、家族ともあまりコミュニケーション取れませんでしたから　機嫌の良いときはすごくいいんですけど…それでも、コロナ禍までは働いていたので、直接のきっかけは派遣切りですね
dialogue.content: Yes, he didn’t communicate much even with family. When he’s in a good mood he can be very pleasant, but… Even so, he was working up until the pandemic, so the immediate trigger was being let go from the temp job.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね。派遣切りとは、突然仕事を一方的に辞めさせられたのでしょうか。
dialogue.content: I see. When you say he was laid off, do you mean he was suddenly let go from his job without much notice?

dialogue.origin: はい　突然です
dialogue.content: Yes, it was sudden.

dialogue.origin: それは、お辛いですよね。ご家族も悲し想いになりますよね。お兄さんが周りの方とコミュケーションをうまくとれないと思われたのはいつごろでしたか。
dialogue.content: That must have been very difficult for him. And sad for your family as well. Around when did you first notice that your brother had trouble communicating well with others?

dialogue.origin: はい　ずっとこんななので…それはざっくりと言えば、私が実家にいた頃からです　つまり学生時代社会人になって職場のタバコの問題が起こったときにちょっと思いました
dialogue.content: Yes... he's always been like this. Broadly speaking, it's been since I was still living at home. It really stood out to me after he started working and that issue with smoking at his workplace happened.

dialogue.origin: 当時は職場でタバコ吸えたみたいで兄は嫌煙家なので、文句？を言ったみたいです
dialogue.content: Apparently, people were allowed to smoke in the workplace back then, and since my brother hates smoking, it seems he complained about it.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね。お兄さんは、学生の頃からコミュケーションがうまくとれない経験をされていたのかもしれませんね。社会人になられて、職場のタバコ問題とはどのような事があったのでしょうか。具体的にお聞きしてもよろしいでしょうか。
dialogue.content: I see. It's possible your brother has had experiences with difficult communication since he was a student. Could you tell me more specifically about what happened with this smoking issue at his workplace?

dialogue.origin: なるほど、お兄さんは、たばこが嫌いなので当然、吸わないで欲しいという意見を述べただけなのに、それを問題にされたのでしょうか。
dialogue.content: I see. So your brother dislikes smoking and naturally just expressed his wish for people not to smoke near him, but that was treated as a problem?

dialogue.origin: はい、おそらくそれで人間関係が気まずくなったので辞めたのか、半ば辞めさせられたのか…詳しくはわからないですが
dialogue.content: Yes, I assume relationships at work became awkward because of it, and he either quit or was more or less forced to leave... I don't know the details, though.

dialogue.origin: それは、驚きました。お兄さんの意見を尊重もせずに、居心地の悪い空間を作られたのか。お兄さんにとっては苦痛を味わったのですね。その時、具体的にご家族には相談等はあったのでしょうか。
dialogue.content: That's quite shocking. To create an uncomfortable atmosphere for him without respecting his opinion... It must have been a very painful experience for your brother. Did he talk to your family about it at the time?

dialogue.origin: 相談…かはわからないですが、私が知っているくらいなので、兄は家族に話をしていたと思います
dialogue.content: I’m not sure you’d call it ‘consulting,’ but since I know about it, I think he did talk to the family.

dialogue.origin: 兄の言い方にも問題があったのかもしれないとは思いますが
dialogue.content: Though I suspect the way my brother said it might have been part of the problem.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか。ご家族にも相談されても、解決とはならずに、お辛い経験をされましたね。その時、ご家族の反応はいかがでしたでしょうか。
dialogue.content: I see. So even though he spoke with your family, it didn't lead to a resolution, and he went through a difficult experience. How did your family react at the time?

dialogue.origin: 両親は会社に対していい感情にはならなかったでしょうけど、せっかく勤めているのに、というような反応もあったと思います
dialogue.content: My parents probably weren't happy with the company, but I think part of their reaction was also along the lines of, 'but you worked so hard to get this job...'

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか。きっと、お兄さんは学生時代からコミュケーションを上手にとる事に悩まれていたとすると、勇気をだして社内で意見を述べたのに、思わぬ反応に戸惑ったと思いますが、ご家族から暖かい言葉をもらえてよかったと思われたと思われますか。
dialogue.content: I see. If your brother had been struggling with communication since his student days, he must have been taken aback by the unexpected reaction after mustering the courage to voice his opinion at work. Do you think he felt glad to receive words of support from your family?

dialogue.origin: どうでしょう…良かったのかどうかそのあたりはよくわからないです両親は兄にはわりと厳しめだったと思いますし
dialogue.content: I’m not sure… I don’t really know if it felt good for him or not. I think our parents tended to be rather strict with my brother.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか。ご両親は、お兄さんには厳しめだったと思われるのですね。具体的に妹さんとは違うな。と思われる事などありますか。
dialogue.content: I see—you feel your parents were fairly strict with your brother. Are there specific ways you felt they treated him differently from you?

dialogue.origin: 何かやりたいとなったときに賛成する雰囲気が、私のときと比べると薄いとかしつけとかはわかりませんが…一回りくらい年上なのでそのあたりはよくわからないです
dialogue.content: For example, when he wanted to do something, the atmosphere of support seemed weaker compared to with me. As for how they disciplined us, I’m not sure—he’s about a dozen years older than I am, so I don’t really know about that period.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか。お兄さんとは歳の差があるようですね。妹さんは、今のお兄さんにどうなって欲しい思われますか。
dialogue.content: I see. It sounds like there's a significant age difference between you. What would you like to see happen for your brother now?

dialogue.origin: まずは働いて自活できるようになってほしいですあとは実家の家屋がもうボロボロなので、1人暮らしを別の場所でしてほしいです
dialogue.content: First, I want him to work and become self-sufficient. Also, our parents’ house is falling apart, so I’d like him to live on his own somewhere else.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。お兄さんに対しての思い理解できます。では、ご両親が少し厳しかった様ですが、今もお兄さんには厳しそうですか？
dialogue.content: I understand how you feel about your brother. You mentioned your parents were somewhat strict—do they still seem strict with him now?

dialogue.origin: いえ、厳しくしてもかえって悪化するので、それはないと思います
dialogue.content: No, I don't think so. Being strict would only make things worse.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね。ご両親は、厳しくはないと言う事ですね。お兄さんとご両親の関係についてはどう思われますか。お兄さんに寄り添って欲しい等思う事はありますか。
dialogue.content: I see. So your parents aren't strict with him now. What are your thoughts on the relationship between your brother and your parents? Do you ever wish they would be more emotionally supportive of him?

dialogue.origin: そうですね…実家のインフラは支払っているのと、時々生活費を援助しているので、既にけっこう助けてると思います
dialogue.content: Well... they're paying for the utilities at the house and sometimes give him money for living expenses, so I think they're already helping him quite a lot.

dialogue.origin: 両親と兄の関係は、時々良いけど遠慮なくものが言える感じではないのかなと思いますすぐに機嫌損ねて、シャットアウトするので、両親は困っています
dialogue.content: My parents' relationship with my brother is good at times, but I don't think they can speak freely with each other. He gets upset easily and shuts them out, so my parents don't know what to do.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。生活費の援助をされているお兄さんも、素直に感謝できなかったり、自活していない息子さんに対して親御さんは優しい言葉がかけられなかったりすると思いますが、その辺はいかがでしょうか。
dialogue.content: I understand. Your brother, who is receiving financial support, may find it hard to express straightforward gratitude, and your parents may find it difficult to speak gently to an adult son who isn’t supporting himself. How do you see that dynamic?

dialogue.origin: 両親は心配はしていると思いますが、兄もそれをわかっていながらも素直にはなかなかならないでしょうね
dialogue.content: I'm sure my parents are worried, but even though my brother knows that, he probably has a hard time being receptive to it.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。お話を聴いていて、感じた事を少し話してもよろしいでしょうか。
dialogue.content: I see. As I've been listening, a thought has come to mind. Would it be all right if I shared it with you?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 人とコミュケーションをうまく取れない傾向にあるお兄さんが、会社で嫌な思いをしたことが深い傷を負ってしまっているのかもしれません。まずは、家族の優しい言葉や信頼関係を築く事で回復する力がうまれるかもしれないと思いますが、いかがでしょうか。
dialogue.content: It's possible that for your brother, who already tends to struggle with communication, the bad experience he had at his company left a very deep wound. Perhaps building trust and offering gentle words as a family could be the first step in creating the strength he needs to recover. What are your thoughts on that?

dialogue.origin: そうですね…やっぱり私からも連絡をとったほうがいいでしょうかね
dialogue.content: That makes sense… Do you think I should reach out to him myself as well?

dialogue.origin: いつも嫌な雰囲気で話が終わるので、なんか取りづらくてずっと時間が経ってしまいました
dialogue.content: Our conversations always end on an unpleasant note, so it's been difficult to contact him, and so much time has passed.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。家族会議ってそうなりますよね。よく分かります。ご家族もお兄さんに多くを望んでいらっしゃらないと思いますが、先ずは人と過ごすことは楽しい事であり、つらい時は支え合える家族がいる。という事を話し合ってみる事はいかがでしょうか。
dialogue.content: I understand. Family discussions can often end up that way. I completely get it. I'm sure your family isn't expecting too much from him. Perhaps you could start by trying to talk about how spending time with people can be enjoyable, and that he has a family that can support him through difficult times. What do you think of that?

dialogue.origin: はいとりあえず困っていることはあるか、聞いてみようかと思います
dialogue.content: Yes, I’ll start by asking if there’s anything he’s struggling with.

dialogue.origin: 一度、殻を閉じてしまうと友人や他人から何を言われてもなかなか気持ちが前向きになれないと思います。心から心配している家族の存在はお兄さんにもきっと大きな力になると思います。いかがでしょうか。
dialogue.content: Once someone retreats into their shell, it can be very difficult to feel positive, no matter what friends or other people say. I believe the presence of a family that is genuinely worried about him could be a great source of strength for your brother. What do you think?

dialogue.origin: 家族だから、余計に言うことを素直にはきけないんですよねかと言って、友人との繋がりももうほとんどないと思うし…とりあえず家族ですかね
dialogue.content: It's because we're family that it's harder for him to listen without getting defensive. That said, I don't think he has much contact with friends anymore... So, I suppose it has to start with family.

dialogue.origin: ご結婚されても、実家の両親やお兄さんの事を心配されている娘さんであり妹さんの存在はご家族からみても大きな安心感につながると思います。きっとうまくいくと信じています。
dialogue.content: Even though you're married now, the fact that you're still a daughter and sister who worries about her parents and brother must be a great source of comfort for your family. I believe you can make a positive difference.

dialogue.origin: はい、ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: 少し気持ちが落ち着きましたか？お話をお聞かせいただきありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Are you feeling a little more at ease? Thank you for sharing your story with me today.

dialogue.origin: はい、聴いてくださりありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you for listening.

dialogue.origin: 相談に来ていただきありがとうございました。 本日はこれで終了とさせていただきます。
dialogue.content: Thank you for coming in for counseling today. We'll conclude our session here.

dialogue.origin: （お疲れ様でした。お相手いただき、ありがとうございました。）
dialogue.content: (Thank you for your time. I appreciate you meeting with me.)

dialogue.origin: （ありがとうございました。勉強になりました）
dialogue.content: (Thank you very much. I learned a lot.)

dialogue.origin: （ロールプレイを終了いたします。ありがとうございます。またお願いいたします。）
dialogue.content: (This concludes the role-play. Thank you, and I look forward to working with you again.)

topic.sub: 兄とのコミュニケーション問題
